text:
mira: FYI the sample-app publish was blocked by the release gate after a typegen regen. I didn't touch public APIs, just reran the generator. CI flagged a semver risk around parameter ordering. Anyone seen this pattern?
eli: drop the diff if you can? quick look helps.
mira: small snippet: ```diff
- func UpdateAccount(ctx context.Context, id string, opts UpdateOpts) error
+ func UpdateAccount(ctx context.Context, opts UpdateOpts, id string) error
```
gaben: sigh, that's the nondeterministic parameter ordering bug. generator sorting fell back to map order for parameters when author/locale metadata was missing. we've hit this before.
ci-bot: pipeline: typegen-check failed. exit 3. regen-diff detected. potential-semver: parameter-ordering. action: release-gate: BLOCKED.
carla: did the changelog generator mark this as a breaking change too? that's what triggers semver bumps.
mira: yes, changelog heuristics treated it as signature change and bumped the release notes.
eli: the Go SDK also had an auth/retry parity test flake last week; i wonder if both stem from nondet iteration order in some codepath.
gaben: root cause: our stable-sort function wasn't applied in the legacy typegen path. when metadata is missing, it doesn't compute the stable key and we end up with map iteration order.
mira: short-term fix: run `make typegen-stable` locally in sample-app and commit. Long-term: enforce deterministic sort in the generator and add a unit test for missing metadata.
carla: i'll open a tiny patch to the generator that constructs deterministic sort keys: (path, operationId|empty, parameterName). will add test for missing author/locale and for non-US locales.
regen-bot: suggestion: label regen-diff as "reorder-only" if only parameter order changed and no types/signatures changed. This reduces false-positive semver signals.
mira: I ran local stable regen: `make typegen-stable && git add . && git commit -m "regen: stable sort for deterministic params" && git push`. output: "stable sort complete, no diffs"
ci-bot: re-run typegen-check: PASS. release-gate: PASS.
gaben: perfect. carla, assign the generator PR to me/eli for review. mira, thanks for the quick regen.
carla: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/489 — adds deterministic sort and tests covering locale-less cases. also updates changelog heuristics to not treat pure param reorders as breaking.
eli: i'll follow up to see if the auth/retry flaky test is related; might add a deterministic ordering utility to the go-sdk tests too.
mira: resolved on our side, sample-app publish proceeded. closing thread but will watch for similar flakes.
regen-bot: note: changelog heuristics updated in PR to add a "reorder-only" classification; this will prevent unnecessary semver bumps in the future.
ci-bot: queued: add integration test that runs typegen under different locales and with missing author metadata.
mira: thanks everyone :party_parrot: — closing.
